rationale: TSLA is mid-digestion of a LIVE post-earnings gap-down (375->359) with the guidance call still open and cash market closed — thin after-hours tape can gap violently both ways, so there is no clean directional edge. Chasing a long into an unresolved binary is equally unattractive. Wait for the binary to resolve at a real level.
